**Roger Rasmussen: (Nattefrost)**Vocals, drums, guitar, keyboards, and bass.

**Roger Rasmussen**, better known by the stage name**Nattefrost**, is a Norwegian musician, best known for being the vocalist and a founding member of black metal band[Carpathian Forest](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carpathian_Forest).He also fronts the side projects[World Destroyer](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=World_Destroyer&action=edit&redlink=1)and[Kreft](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kreft), and since 2003 also has a solo project of his own. In 2000 Nattefrost formed his first side project, World Destroyer, alongside Eivind Kulde and his Carpathian Forest bandmate[Daniel Vrangsinn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vrangsinn). The band released a demo album,Diabolical Quest, in 2004; it is their only release so far. He would form the duo Kreft in 2011 alongside Patolog Falk,releasing in the same year the EP Lommemannen.

![Image 5: Prince](https://www.grindinthecore.com/sites/default/files/inline-images/Prince2.jpg)

Prince

**Prince:**vocals, guitar, bass, keyboards, and drums.

**Prince Rogers Nelson**(June 7, 1958– April 21, 2016) was an American singer-songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, record producer, actor, and director. He was known for his flamboyant and androgynous persona, eclectic work, and wide vocal range, which included a far-reaching falsetto and high-pitched screams. He often played most or all instruments on his recordings.

Prince's music incorporated a wide variety of styles, including funk, R&B, rock, new wave, soul, synth-pop, pop, jazz, and hip hop. He pioneered the[Minneapolis sound](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minneapolis_sound), a funk rock subgenre that emerged in the late 1970s.He had a prolific output, releasing 39 albums during his life, with a vast array of unreleased projects left in a vault at his home after his death.

![Image 6: Paul McCartney](https://www.grindinthecore.com/sites/default/files/inline-images/Paul.jpeg)

Paul McCartney

**Paul McCartney: (The Beatles and Wings)**bass, guitar, vocals, keyboards, and drums.

**Sir James Paul McCartney**[CH](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Companion_of_Honour)[MBE](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Order_of_the_British_Empire)(born 18 June 1942) is an English singer, songwriter, musician, and record and film producer who gained worldwide fame as co-lead vocalist, co-songwriter, and bassist for[the Beatles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Beatles). His songwriting partnership with[John Lennon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Lennon)remains the most successful in history. After the group disbanded in 1970, he pursued a solo career and formed the band[Wings](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_McCartney_and_Wings)with his first wife,[Linda](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Linda_McCartney), and[Denny Laine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Denny_Laine).

A self-taught musician, McCartney is proficient on bass, guitar, keyboards, and drums. He is known for his melodic approach to bass-playing (mainly playing with a plectrum), his versatile and wide tenor vocal range (spanning over four octaves), and his eclecticism (exploring styles ranging from pre-rock and roll pop to classical and electronica).

![Image 7: Flea](https://www.grindinthecore.com/sites/default/files/inline-images/Flea.jpeg)

Flea

**Flea: (Red Hot Chili Peppers)**bass, guitar, trumpet, drums, keyboards, and vocals.

**Michael Peter Balzary**(born 16 October 1962), known professionally as**Flea**, is an Australian-American musician and actor. He is a founding member and the bassist of the rock band[Red Hot Chili Peppers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_Hot_Chili_Peppers). Flea briefly appeared as the bassist for such bands as[What Is This?](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/What_Is_This%3F),[Fear](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fear_(band)), and[Jane's Addiction](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jane%27s_Addiction). He has performed with rock[s](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Supergroup_(music))upergroups[Atoms for Peace](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atoms_for_Peace_(band)),[Antemasque](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Antemasque_(band)),[Pigface](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pigface), and[Rocket Juice & the Moon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rocket_Juice_%26_the_Moon), and collaborated with[the Mars Volta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Mars_Volta),[Johnny Cash](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Johnny_Cash),[Tom Waits](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tom_Waits),[Alanis Morissette](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alanis_Morissette), and[Young MC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Young_MC). Flea also performed live with[Nirvana](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nirvana_(band))in 1993 playing the trumpet.

Flea incorporates elements of funk (including slap bass), psychedelic, punk, and hard rock in his style of playing. In 2009,[Rolling Stone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rolling_Stone)readers ranked Flea the second best bassist of all time, behind only[John Entwistle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Entwistle).In 2012, he and the other members of Red Hot Chili Peppers were inducted into the[Rock and Roll Hall of Fame](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rock_and_Roll_Hall_of_Fame).

![Image 8: Jef Whitehead](https://www.grindinthecore.com/sites/default/files/inline-images/Jef2.jpg)

Jef Whitehead

**Jef Whitehead: (Leviathan)**guitar, bass, vocals, drums, and keyboards.

**Leviathan**is an American black metal solo project that started in 1998 by Jef Whitehead under the pseudonym Wrest. On all Leviathan albums, Wrest records all instruments and performs vocals on his own. Despite having early problems with the release of the fourth album[Massive Conspiracy Against All Life](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massive_Conspiracy_Against_All_Life), it was released March 24, 2008 in Europe and on March 25, 2008 in North America. Additionally, Wrest has collaborated with the band[Sunn O)))](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sunn_(band)), and he was an active member of the U.S. black metal supergroup[Twilight](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twilight_(band))from its formation until it disbanded in 2014. He has stated in interviews that he has been playing drums longer than any other instrument and that the drums are his instrument of choice. Wrest also played and recorded all instruments as well as vocals in his other project, Lurker of Chalice, which had two demos and one full-length album in 2005 released before it was dissolved. Whitehead also writes all the lyrics for Leviathan but has noted, "I don't consider myself a poet by any means."

![Image 9: Phil Collins](https://www.grindinthecore.com/sites/default/files/inline-images/Phil2.jpg)
